style: Hand-painted 2D video game texture in the style of Eyvind Earle's mid-century poster illustrations combined with the saturated colors of Rayman Legends: flat opaque gouache shapes with crisp hard edges, exactly three tones per surface (light, mid, shadow), fine stippled dots along the shadow edges, subtle paper grain, no gradients, no soft airbrush, no photorealism, no text, no watermark. Subject:

assets.name: paper_grain
assets.prompt: a sheet of very subtle fine warm off-white paper grain, almost uniform cream color with tiny faint speckles and fibers, a seamless tileable texture filling the entire frame edge to edge, no objects, no border, no vignette.
